actions.name: Exploit CVE-2019-18935 in Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX on IIS server
actions.description: Threat actors exploited a .NET deserialization vulnerability (CVE-2019-18935) in Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX running on a Microsoft IIS server to achieve remote code execution.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: Upload malicious DLL files to C:\Windows\Temp\ directory
actions.description: Threat actors uploaded malicious dynamic-link library (DLL) files, some masqueraded as PNG files, to the C:\Windows\Temp\ directory on the IIS server.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: Execute malicious DLL files via w3wp.exe process
actions.description: Threat actors executed the uploaded malicious DLL files from the C:\Windows\Temp\ directory via the legitimate w3wp.exe process on the IIS server.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: Delete DLL files with .dll extension from C:\Windows\Temp\ directory
actions.description: Threat Actor 1's malware deleted DLL files with the .dll extension from the C:\Windows\Temp\ directory, possibly to hide malicious activity.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: Use timestomping technique to modify file creation dates
actions.description: Threat actors used timestomping to modify file time attributes to insert misleading creation dates on malicious files.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: Conduct reconnaissance and scanning activities
actions.description: Threat actors conducted reconnaissance and scanning activities correlating to the exploitation of CVE-2019-18935 on the IIS server.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: TA2 malware drops and executes reverse shell utilities
actions.description: Threat Actor 2 (TA2) malware dropped and executed reverse shell utilities for unencrypted communication with C2 servers.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: TA2 malware attempts to connect to C2 servers and establish listener
actions.description: TA2 malware attempts to connect to C2 servers to obtain IP address and port number for unencrypted communication and establishes a listener if successful.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: TA2 malware creates appropriate shell and sends system info to C2
actions.description: If communication is established, TA2 malware identifies the OS, creates the appropriate shell (cmd or bash), and sends system information back to the C2 server.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: TA2 malware downloads and drops base64 encoded ASPX webshell
actions.description: TA2 malware downloads a base64 encoded webshell (small.txt) from the C2 server, decodes it as small.aspx, and places it in the C:\Windows\Temp\ directory.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: TA1 malware enumerates system and network information
actions.description: TA1 malware enumerates system, processes, files, directories, and collects network parameters including host name, domain name, DNS server IP, NetBIOS ID, adapter info, IP address, subnet, gateway IP, and DHCP server.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: TA1 malware communicates collected data to C2 server
actions.description: TA1 malware communicates collected system and network data to C2 servers at IP addresses 137.184.130[.]162 or 45.77.212[.]12 using unencrypted TCP over port 443.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.
